title: Exceptions and using map
intro: This module teaches how C# signals and handles failures. You will learn what an exception is, how try/catch/finally and when filters work, which types to catch at a worker boundary, why throw; preserves the stack trace, and how using calls IDisposable for deterministic cleanup of native resources like SkiaSharp surfaces.

overviewDiagram.title: Failure handling and cleanup flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  START[Normal code runs] --> THROW{Failure?}
  THROW -->|no| OK[Continue]
  THROW -->|yes| UNWIND[CLR unwinds stack]
  UNWIND --> CATCH{Matching catch or when filter?}
  CATCH -->|yes| HANDLE[Handler runs]
  CATCH -->|no| DIE[Unhandled — thread ends]
  HANDLE --> FINALLY[finally runs cleanup]
  FINALLY --> RETHROW{throw; or continue?}
  RETHROW -->|rethrow| UNWIND
  RETHROW -->|done| OK
  OK --> USING[using calls Dispose]
  USING --> DONE[Resources released]

conceptCards.title: What is an exception
conceptCards.summary: A typed object derived from System.Exception. throw signals failure; the CLR unwinds the stack until a catch matches or the thread dies.

conceptCards.title: try, catch, finally, and filters
conceptCards.summary: try wraps risky code. catch handles specific types. finally always runs. when filters catch a subset without swallowing sibling failures.

conceptCards.title: Exception hierarchy
conceptCards.summary: Catch specific types at boundaries. Retry transient faults like TimeoutException. Let programming bugs bubble — never catch (Exception) { return; } in a worker.

conceptCards.title: throw versus throw ex
conceptCards.summary: throw; rethrows and preserves StackTrace. throw ex; resets it — the classic bug. Wrap with InnerException once at a boundary.
conceptCards.example: catch (JsonException ex) { throw new InvalidOperationException("invalid", ex); }

conceptCards.title: using and IDisposable
conceptCards.summary: using is try/finally that calls Dispose. Essential for SkiaSharp and file streams. await using calls DisposeAsync for async resources.
